title: Learn it first and Learn more links
description: Free lessons from the allowed providers (Oak National Academy, BBC Bitesize, Isaac Physics / Isaac Science) for one topic, or for some of its learning points or items. Links only: nothing is loaded from those sites until the student taps one. A link shows only when it is reachable (checked_at) and match-checked (match). One file per topic, named <topic id>.json.

topic.description: Id of a topic in content/topic-trees/.

title.description: The page title exactly as the provider shows it.

board.description: Only for a board-specific page: must match the topic tree's board.

checked_at.description: ISO date the link was last confirmed reachable (the CI link check), or null until then.

learning_points.description: Only for a page about these learning points of the topic. Without learning_points or items the link is for the whole topic.

items.description: Only for a page about these items (questions) of the topic.

match.description: The recorded content check: someone opened the page and confirmed it teaches this topic (or point) at this level. Never filled in for a page that was not opened. The app shows a link only with a match check.

page_title.description: The page's <title> as fetched. The CI link check fails if it changes, so the match is re-checked.

teaches.description: What the page teaches, as read on the page.

level.description: The level the page says it is for.

checked_at.description: ISO date the page was read.
